description: Licences Microsoft gives a tenant without a purchase: free, self-service and trial allotments, usually ten thousand or a million seats. The report leaves them out of its count of paid seats nobody is using. A licence holding a million seats or more is treated the same whether or not it is listed here.
source: Microsoft's product names and service plan identifiers for licensing (learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity/users/licensing-service-plan-reference). The part numbers were written from that list and are to be confirmed against a tenant that holds each (verify).
